title: analysis@v1
description: Subject-matter analysis over a set of reading notes, organised by the brief's required aspects. The stage between reading and writing: what the sources establish TOGETHER, where they diverge, what follows. Gaps get one narrow field per aspect on purpose — a live run without this stage turned the missing material into the report's subject.

aspects.description: One entry per required aspect of the brief, in the brief's own order. An aspect the notes cannot support still gets an entry — with `established` empty and `material_gaps` filled.

aspect.description: The aspect as the brief formulates it.

established.description: What the sources establish about the SUBJECT when read together. Each finding is a substantive statement, not a remark about a source's availability or quality.

statement.description: One self-contained substantive statement, in the report's language.

notes.description: Identifiers of the notes carrying it (each note's `source` field). Two or more means independent corroboration — unless a note marks its source as a restatement or compilation.

locator.description: Where in the source it sits, as the note recorded it.

figures.description: Quantities this finding rests on, each with its period, carried over verbatim from the notes.

sequence.description: Dated order of events the aspect turns on. A gap in the order is a result of analysis; no single note could assemble it.

divergences.description: Where sources disagree: both positions with attribution, plus which is better founded and why. Material for analysis, not a defect to hide.

primacy.description: How direct this source is on this point, as the note recorded it.

assessment.description: Which position carries more weight and on what ground. Empty if the notes do not settle it.

comparison.description: The compared cases set against each other dimension by dimension — what makes a report comparative rather than a pile of separate write-ups. What the cases are (jurisdictions, vendors, methods, periods, populations) comes from the brief.

cases.description: What each compared case shows on this dimension.

implications.description: What follows from the findings for the state of the matter and where it is heading — the outlook half of most assignments. Derived from the material, never from general knowledge of the field.

material_gaps.description: What the notes do not carry for this aspect. ONE line per gap: the report states it once and moves on. Deliberately narrow — an aspect's gaps are not its subject.

single_source_findings.description: Findings resting on one substantive source, so the report can mark them where they are stated instead of discussing its sourcing at length.

cross_aspect.description: Observations visible only across aspects — a commitment that explains a rule that explains a pattern in practice. The raw material of the concluding section.
